findings.finding: Enabled documents, desktop and screenshot preferences build LibrarySource.media; capture builds LibrarySource.capture. Downloads is a separate per-profile folder query.
Screenshots resolves com.apple.screencapture location, expanding tilde, with Desktop fallback for absent/non-string values.
Source directories are resolved into a URL set before listing; overlapping Desktop/Screenshots sources do not duplicate rows.
LibrarySource.media maps file items through URL media eligibility helper 0x100b1eaa4.
Media means UTType.image or UTType.movie; PDF and audio are excluded. URL content type has a filename-extension fallback in 0x100b1e2cc.
Hover library query sets sources only. Its default optional limit is nil (0x10268d434), and predicate 0x100003b68 returns true. Media is therefore filtered before final four-row selection.
File recency uses NSFileModificationDate. The existing download-only ABI keeps this behavior.
CaptureContentState has saveToLibrary separately from activeSessionState. ArcUserDefaultSettings case 80 is saveCaptureToLibrary.
CaptureAction switch maps didToggleSaveToLibrary to 0x100201e78 and onDidTapCopyCapturedImage to 0x100201ee8; do not equate copying with saving.
Source reconfiguration filters existing HomeBadgingDataItem.download entries with Downloads preference key 4; when disabled, entries are skipped at 0x1026d57c0.

DownloadAction.create wraps and inserts DownloadData at 0x1026d1e18 without checking source preferences. New live downloads can appear while Downloads is disabled until another source reconfiguration.
DownloadAction.onDownloadsInitialized (case 7) follows cleanup/no-op through 0x1026d1b64. Restored browser history is not a live preview arrival; folder files fill the preview separately.

CaptureData keeps id, source URL, createdDate, optional text, captureType and captureLayoutInfo. Layout records document size, scroll offset and selected frame relative to the viewport (descriptor 0x103d34f2c).
The selected capture action label is Saved to Library; initializer 0x10032edc0 constructs Save to Library. Content-state menu builder 0x1002de67c consumes these labels separately from Copy and Save….
The other direct NSUserDefaults registerDefaults call registers NSApplicationCrashOnExceptions=true, not capture saving. The capture save default remains unresolved.
